name: Yua
source:
"But I absolutely *adore* that side of you! <3 I can't wait for us to blow up together—to become one big, sizzling-hot, mixed-meat hamburger of human and android... <3"

An android with an unstable mental program. She loves hearing about other people's romances and adores the concept of having a "crush". She latches onto any hint of a frivolous romantic fling the moment she catches wind of it.

Once she gets angry, she tends to go berserk for a while— sometimes even brushing ever-so-lightly against the law.

In case of emergencies, she keeps a "Self-Destruct Device"—which she affectionately calls her "Binding Device"— strapped to her body at all times.
